cell_line: Permission to use the human embryonic stem cell line (hESC) ES04 (WiCell institute) was obtained from the Cornell/Rockefeller/Sloan Kettering tri-institutional ESC research oversight committee.
cell_type: mesenchymal stem cells, embryonic stem cells

Here we performed an in depth characterization of human ESC-MSC, comparing them to human bone marrow-derived MSC (BM-MSC) as well as human embryonic stem cells (hESC) by transcriptomics (RNA-seq) and quantitative proteomics (nanoLC-MS/MS using SILAC).

sex: Since the origin ESC line is male, only male BM-MSC donors were selected.
species: MS data was analyzed by MaxQuant suite of algorithms version 1.4.1.2 using a Homo Sapiens database downloaded from UniprotKB on the 27th of November 2013 and comprising 88,473 protein isoforms entries.
